how.rule: Net sales (excl. VAT) − purchase cost (units × landed unit cost) = gross profit before commission − broker commission = profit after commission. No expenses, taxes or net profit here: those are in Monthly P&L. A deal counts once, when it's fully paid. Until delivery, its cost uses the current average purchase cost.
how.ruleShort: Net sales (excl. VAT) − units × landed unit cost − broker commission = profit. Expenses are in Monthly P&L. A deal counts once, when it's fully paid.
